brand.wordmark_font: Montserrat 300, letter-spacing 0.09em, soft glow as in the logotype
brand.rule: the logotype (mark.svg + wordmark) is used exactly as designed, on violet-black bands (header, footer); the rest of the UI is calm: no glows

validation: dataviz validate_palette.js --pairs all: light s1-s3 on #ffffff all checks pass (CVD dE 11.9); dark s1-s3 on #161920 all pass (CVD dE 9.0). The benchmark is a neutral reference line, thinner and labelled. Max 3 series per chart; more -> small multiples.
